key_phrases: Full Self-Driving will become the most important source of profitability
supply chain will continue to be the fundamental limiter
not introducing new vehicle models this year
Optimus... potential to be more significant than the vehicle business
analysis.reasoning: The call reflects a highly successful 2021 with massive volume growth (90%) and record profitability. Management is extremely bullish on long-term technological moats like FSD, Dojo, and Optimus. However, there is a clear, realistic warning regarding supply chain constraints (chips) and inflation acting as headwinds for 2022. While Elon Musk was somewhat evasive on the $25k car and specific timelines for certain products, he provided high quantitative specificity regarding past performance and future growth targets (>50%).
